papers.title: Fast Weight Attention for Continual Learning
papers.authors: Zhang, Ta, Yuan, Wang, Gu, Yao et al.
papers.what: Reads the state update of a selective state-space model as an online learning rule, argues the standard same-step association optimises the wrong target under autoregressive semantics, and derives a family of normalised least-mean-squares updates (Falcon-1/2/3) that keep language modelling competitive while improving length extrapolation.
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017, PHB9VRVM); Mamba-2 (Dao 2024, JPKDWV2Q); Mamba (Gu 2024, XNI34DQX)

papers.title: ContextPilot: Teaching Agents for Proactive Context Management via Fine-grained RL
papers.authors: Pan, Pei, Lu, Lin et al. (Tencent)
papers.what: Trains an agent to edit its own working context, adding planning, long-term memory and soft offloading tools, and assigns credit per editing action from branched trajectories rather than spreading one trajectory-level reward across every edit, which yields stronger long-context results at a smaller context size.
papers.builds_on: Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026, BDY3HUCV); ToolkenGPT (Hao 2024, 6RDHVVA2); LATS (Zhou 2024, 77ERE7HA)

papers.title: J-Zero: Unified Challenger--Solver--Judge Co-Evolution from Zero Data
papers.what: Carries self-evolving training into domains with no verifier by co-adapting a Judge on preference pairs whose ordering is known from how each response was generated rather than from the Judge's own scores, gaining 4.2 points on verifiable and 8.0 on unverifiable domains and improving for ten iterations where baselines collapse after two.

papers.title: Code as Worlds: Agentic Discovery of Executable World Representations for Physical Reasoning
papers.authors: Wang, Cai, Chen, Liu, Long, Wu et al. (MirroS Lab)
papers.what: Writes a physical scene as executable code rather than a latent vector and recovers that program from video through an abductive propose-execute-render-verify loop, turning unlabelled observation into verified quantitative supervision and reaching state of the art on QuantiPhy above proprietary models.
papers.builds_on: World Models (Ha 2018, 938DAXZT); Evaluating World Models (Vafa 2024, P92FLHJ2); PyVision (Zhao 2025, XQTY5MPI)
